content2.content: While system notifications have a standard look, you can customize them to match your brand or provide richer content.

content4.content: On Android, you can use `RemoteViews` to create completely custom notification layouts. This requires platform-specific code.

content6.content: You can add buttons (e.g., 'Reply', 'Mark as Read') or text input fields directly to the notification.

content8.content: Customizations allow for unique user experiences but require more effort to implement across platforms.
